g.data-name: Artwork / fitted bitmap, source preserved separately
UNCOMMON / antique bronze, paired rules, leaf corners
Rarity / antique bronze, paired rules, leaf corners
Portrait inlay / rank and figure emblems

text.tspan: A dispatch copyist preserves the wording of orders before
they travel far from court. Exact attention keeps authority
from changing with each retelling, giving officials a
shared instruction they can read and answer.
